Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • auto-task: add vault target support for auto tasks (1fe94c9)
  • prompts: add GitHub About optimization prompts (75badd2)
  • hero: add primary profession preset system with vault provider (8ad7650)
  • doubao: enhance WebSocket session management (565727b)
  • proposal: add proposal optimization bundle system (73b1be6)
  • frontend: add frontend configuration management (a766f0b)
  • vault: add project vault management system (5d28a93)
  • license: add startup background service for license activation (b3244c6)
  • license: add Keygen client and license service (aa399d5)
  • quick-actions: add application service for command execution (4ce5958)
  • quick-actions: add script-backed command execution domain service (e10a4d6)

HagiCode-org/web

  • i18n: add translations for vault and proposal optimization features (31b7d57)
  • types: add proposal optimization readiness and vault target support (c59dbe8)
  • proposal: update proposal optimization with readiness and retry support (990d474)
  • vault: enhance vault with auto-compose commit and management (a1fa6c0)
  • git: add GitHub about optimization action to git status panel (72bfff6)
  • voice: enhance voice recognition with diagnostics and telemetry (19f1666)
  • audio: add telemetry stats to audio processor worklet (3f7b325)
  • styles: use bundled fonts instead of runtime fontsource imports (37c864c)
  • utils: add conversation mode preference storage (7e025d7)
  • signalr: add session realtime snapshot support (27c09a9)
  • config: add frontend config sync feature (691f05b)
  • proposal: add proposal optimization feature (bca443e)
  • vault: add vault management feature (a025aec)
  • build: add repository-managed font bundling workflow (9e4cc28)
  • i18n: update quick actions command help translations (1b99f92)
  • quickActions: add script wrapping clarification and test coverage (fd476d8)
